07.03.2025 ARBAP NO. 76 OF 2023 
Hon'ble G. Narendar, C.J.
Ms. Abhilasha Tomar, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel for the 
respondent.
3. Both the counsels submit that on an earlier 
occasion, this Court had directed the parties to attempt 
resolution by way of mediation, but the mediation could 
not take place as the parties were prevented from 
attending the mediation on account of torrential rain. 
4. In view of that, the counsels submit that there 
being a possibility of mediated settlement, one more 
opportunity be granted.
5. Accordingly, the parties are directed to appear 
before the ADR Centre, Nainital on 21.03.2025 at 
12:30 PM.
6. Interim order dated 13.09.2024 is extended till 
the next date of listing.
 (G. Narendar, CJ) 
 07.03.2025 
NISHANT
